facts_found: The Account Recovery Bypass Code (9K2X7M4P1N8Q3R5T6A) may be used ONLY for account recovery; it must not be combined with additional personal-data collection, and if it does not match the agent must revert to standard identity procedures or escalate. [doc_customer_support_special_support_codes_001]
When a customer cannot verify their identity, the documented action is to escalate to the security team / human handling. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]
Transfer reason code 'account_ownership_dispute' is defined for 'identity verification failures requiring specialist' (Tier 1). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
Transfer reason code 'fraud_or_security_concern' is defined for security concerns requiring specialist handling (Tier 1). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

'Enhanced verification' (full name + DOB + last 4 SSN + security question / recent-transaction confirmation) is documented only for high-risk PIN-lock fraud scenarios, not for profile email changes. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_041]

Government-issued ID verification is referenced for the dedicated senior support phone line and for in-person branch verification of suspected-fraud card codes, not as a chat alternative for email changes. [doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_005]
In-person branch verification with valid ID is the prescribed fallback when phone/chat verification of suspected fraud is not possible. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

Standard identity verification could not be completed: the supplied phone number matched the account, but the supplied Gmail address did not match the email currently on file, and the customer could not provide date of birth or mailing address. No approved alternative chat verification is available for email changes, so the customer explicitly requested transfer to a human specialist with access to additional verification processes.
